confidence.reason: Official career history and the management interview establish the businesses and 2009 TV launch. The podcast publisher describes his jingles and signature voice; contemporary reporting corroborates the launch.

long_biography.plain_text:
Tarek Nour's Schweppes advertising with actor Hassan Abdeen turned a product promotion into a story. The campaign used a celebrity and a narrative at a time when jingles were the familiar format, and it remained one of his favourite pieces of work. Before making commercials, he sang and played keyboards in The Mass, performing covers of the Beatles and the Beach Boys. He later presented a programme on Radio Cairo.

A radio advertisement for a friend's shop brought him his first television commission, for a dandruff shampoo. He moved from producing individual commercials to developing programmes that could attract large audiences and provide airtime for advertisers. Ramadan programming supplied a particularly valuable audience; he bought airtime from state television and sold it on to advertising clients.
